relationships.subject: STK-001
relationships.evidence_quote: STK-001 increases expression of SCN1A mRNA and NaV1.1 protein, without affecting expression of the paralogs

relationships.subject: STK-001
relationships.evidence_quote: Another preclinical study further showed that STK-001 rescued the defect in parvalbumin-positive inhibitory interneuron excitability

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD blocks INaR currents of Nav1.6 at a concentration that spares peak transient current, and to reduce neuronal excitability

key_findings: Review of subtype-selective Nav-channel drug development across epilepsy, cardiac, muscle and pain indications.
Nav1.1 upregulation by ASO STK-001 and Nav1.6 targeting are leading epilepsy strategies; Nav1.7/Nav1.8 are the peripheral pain targets.
